pytest_args_reason: The sweep scopes to RpcRetryTests, which exercises the transport retry loop with in-memory openers and needs no external artifact. The rest of the file is left in place; narrowing here is about which guards the score covers -- the truncation-retry path -- not about hiding a class that would fail. Every declared mutant lives in that path and is killed by those tests, so nothing killable only outside RpcRetryTests is claimed.
record_is_not_evidence_of_correctness: a killed mutant shows a guard is load-bearing, not that the guard is right
